scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)
other_conditions: The grant is only admissible for the first marriage of the bride and groom, but a widow is eligible for a second marriage.
Either or both of the bride and groom must belong to Scheduled Castes (including Neo‑Buddhists), Vimukta Castes, Nomadic Tribes (including Dhangars and Vanjaris), or Special Backward Classes.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹10,000 to eligible couples and an incentive of ₹2,000 per couple to institutions organizing mass marriage ceremonies.
